notes: Stateful API requests now carry the encrypted Telegram CloudStorage backup and fall back to it when Vercel Runtime Cache is empty or unavailable.
Profile recipient IDs are classified by their allowed SHA-256 identity, so old swapped cache entries are automatically corrected.
Diana cycle reads and updates survive Runtime Cache loss and return a refreshed encrypted backup token.
Work calendar and shared album can read directly from encrypted backup and no longer fail only because a cache write failed.
TickTick OAuth state is server-signed instead of cache-backed; the OAuth token returns through an encrypted handoff and is merged into Telegram CloudStorage immediately.
Products and wishlist list views fall back to encrypted backup when Runtime Cache has no state.
All v0.4.3 fixes remain, including daily quote rotation and clearer mood selection.
